## About
Aluminum Head Rebuilders, Inc. does one thing: cylinder heads. We rebuild them, repair them, weld them, line bore them, and run an exchange program for heads and cams. Import and domestic, from Acura to Volvo.
Our welding and line-boring techniques save time and cores, which means higher profits for the shops we work with. The exchange program takes the guesswork out of estimating repairs, so your estimates stay accurate.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 82 reviews. A reviewer sent our way by a local import shop called us a knowledgeable and trustworthy machine shop, and another thanked Charlie and his team by name.

## Services
- Exchange Cylinder Heads & Cams: Swap your core for a ready head or cam. The exchange program takes the guesswork out of estimating repairs.
- Complete Cylinder Head Repair: Full inspection and rebuild of aluminum cylinder heads, import and domestic.
- Welding & Line Boring Specialists: Welding and line boring for aluminum cylinder heads, done in house.
- Hard-to-find cylinder heads: Heads that are tough to track down are a specialty here.
- After-market new head castings: New head castings when a rebuild isn't the right call.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on import or domestic heads?
A: Both. Our catalog covers makes including Acura, Audi, BMW, Chrysler, Ford, GM, Honda, Subaru, Toyota, Volkswagen and Volvo.

Q: Is the work warrantied?
A: Yes. Our cylinder head work carries a 12 month, 12,000 mile warranty.

Q: How do I ask about wholesale or place an order?
A: Email info@aluminumheads.com or give us a call during business hours, Monday through Friday.

Q: I'm outside Portland. Which number should I call?
A: Call 1-800-978-HEAD (4323).
